What the brief shows in favor: the coin is alive, graduated, and class ORGANIC, with no airdrop dump seen. The first two minutes after graduation had 420 buyers and 227 SOL of buying (ex-agent), and the top-5 buyer share (14.8%) and top-3 holder share (8.5%) look diversified. Buyers outnumbered sellers in the first two minutes.

What undercuts it, more strongly: the coin is down 89% from its 30-minute high and down 89% over 30 minutes. In the last 15 minutes, sells (14.42 SOL) exceeded buys (13.11 SOL), net flow was negative, and buyers (61) were fewer than sellers (58) with the price still falling. Early buyers appear to be exiting, and the launch bot plus a 1.03 sell-to-buy ratio in the first minutes suggests the early demand was not durable. Pool depth of 31 SOL means a $20 ticket faces meaningful impact, and a round trip costs 1.4-5.1% before any move.

Nothing in the brief shows demand that will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. The honest scout call is to skip.

A thin 31 SOL pool means a $20 round trip costing 1.4-5.1% plus impact will eat any small bounce, and the early launch-bot and sell-to-buy ratio of about 1.03 suggest flippers already exited.
